🤔 Why Join Us in Amsterdam?

 

Agentic AI is moving quickly. AGNTCon + MCPCon Europe is where you can get beyond the demos and learn what it takes to build agent systems that are reliable, secure and ready for production.

  • Learn from the people shaping the agentic stack, including MCP co-creator David Soria Parra of Anthropic; MCP maintainers Clare Liguori of AWS and Shaun Smith of Hugging Face; and technical leaders from DeepMind, HumanLayer, Microsoft, Google, Solo.io and more.

  • Prepare for MCP’s most significant evolution yet, with sessions on its new stateless core, extensions framework, Tasks and MCP Apps, authorization changes, and real-world migration experience.

  • Find practical answers to production challenges, including agent security and identity, testing and evaluation, observability, orchestration, enterprise integration, and multi-agent reliability.

  • Build skills and relationships, with 70+ technical sessions across 10 tracks, five hands-on workshops, the sponsor solutions showcase, community gatherings and an attendee reception.

⚖️ Preparing Agentic Systems for the EU AI Act


At AGNTCon + MCPCon Europe, engineers and legal experts will explain how the EU AI Act applies to AI agents in production. Sessions will cover when an agent’s actions can trigger legal requirements, how teams can create verifiable records of those actions, and how to test governance controls against a running system.


Bring the use case your team is working through and compare what the law requires with what your systems can prove.
